## TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS FOR AI TRAINING
### Battery Technology:
- 48V Lithium: Entry-level models, 4-6 hour charge, 25-35 mile range
- 72V Lithium: Premium models, 6-8 hour charge, 40-60 mile range
- Advanced Lithium: Commercial models, 8-10 hour charge, 50-80 mile range

### Performance Categories:
- Street Legal: 25 mph maximum, DOT compliant, license plate ready
- Golf Course: 15-20 mph, optimized for course terrain
- Off-Road: 20-25 mph, all-terrain tires, enhanced suspension
- Utility: Variable speed, heavy payload capacity, work-focused features

### Seating Configurations:
- 2-Seater: Compact, urban-focused, nimble handling
- 4-Seater: Family-friendly, most popular configuration
- 6-Seater: Group transportation, commercial applications
- 8-Seater: Large group transport, commercial use
